For the past year, I've been using various crypto MCP connections to give me an unfair edge in the financial markets. 
These MCPs allow me to track on-chain data, pull live crypto price feeds, get real-time news updates, and even use AI agents to trade.
Most traders have no idea this is possible (and I don't blame them).
Everyone who is using MCPs in their trading is gatekeeping the sauce.
Today, I am giving you the full list, the setup instructions, and the exact prompts worth using with each one.
This is one of the most valuable crypto articles I could give you, and this information is genuinely hard to find - be sure to save this so you don't lose it.

What Even is an MCP?
If you have been using Claude and wondering how to make it actually useful for crypto research, this is the answer.
MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. 
It is an open standard that allows Claude (or any AI tool) to connect directly to external data sources.
It's like a bridge between Claude's brain and an external tool, in real time.
Without MCP, Claude is working from training data with a knowledge cutoff. 
I.E., it cannot tell you current prices, nor can it track what whales are doing on-chain right now. 
By connecting an MCP, you're essentially giving Claude real-time access to market tools.
 
To gain an edge with MCPs, you don't need to know how they actually work under the hood; just think of them as a bridge between two places (in this case, Claude and a crypto tool).
Let me show you how to set any crypto MCP up in <5 minutes.
 
How to Set Up Any Crypto MCP 
The setup process is almost identical across all MCP servers on this list. 
Learn it once, and you can install any of the ten in under two minutes each.
What you need before starting:
The Claude desktop app - download it at claude.com/download
Node.js - download it at  .org. 
Once you have both of these, there are two methods for installing MCPs:
Connectors
In Claude → Customize → Connectors, you can search for crypto MCPs
At the time of writing, only one of the MCPs on my personal top 10 list is available to connect through this method. Still, I'm including it anyway, as it's the easiest, and I suspect more companies will make their MCPs available this way soon.
 
 2.     Claude Code Prompt Installation
The second method is through prompting Claude Code. This will be your primary method.
Open your Claude Desktop app, switch to Claude Code, and type:
Claude mcp add
Then, when prompted, paste the URL for the connection you want to install, and Claude Code handles everything else automatically.
For example, a full command would look like this:
claude mcp add coingecko https://mcp.api.coingecko.com/mcp *example not real*
 
In my top 10 list below, I include the link to every MCP, so don't worry about sourcing these servers yourself - just paste the link and prompt Claude to help you install it.
Aside from this server URL command, you'll also need an API key from the platform you're trying to install.
My advice: if you can't find where to get an API key, just prompt Claude Code to source the information on how/where to get your free API key for [x] MCP. 
For any troubles during this process, just say: "I'm having trouble installing [x] MCP, help me." 
Now that you know how to install connections, let's dive into my top 10 crypto MCP list.
Each mention includes: a connection link, what the MCP is good for, and example prompts
imo, #10, #2, and #1 are complete game-changers, and the top three you should install ASAP
 
#10: LunarCrush ( @LunarCrush )
LunarCrush is one of the most powerful social intelligence platforms in crypto. 
Installing their MCP allows you to scan social data - what's trending in crypto, social engagement scores, and more.
 
This MCP is super easy to install, since it's the only MCP on this list you can access through the "Connectors" tab in Claude.
 
#9: CoinMarketCap ( @CoinMarketCap ) 
CoinMarketCap is the most widely used crypto data platform in the world. 
I primarily use it for basic data like price feeds, market cap rankings, volume, circulating supply, etc.
 
Connection Link: https://coinmarketcap.com/api/mcp/
 
#8: CryptoPanic 
CryptoPanic is an excellent MCP connection for news.
It pulls breaking news, regulatory updates, market-moving stories, and more in real-time.
 
Connection Link: github.com/kukapay/cryptopanic-mcp-server
 
#7: DeFi Portfolio MCP
This is the connection for anyone actively managing positions across DeFi protocols. 
It is a self-custodial crypto portfolio and DeFi MCP server that lets you read balances and positions across Aave, Compound, Morpho, Uniswap V3 & more and prepares transactions for approval via WalletConnect.
The keyword is self-custodial. Your private keys never leave your device. Claude reads your positions and prepares transactions, but all approvals happen through WalletConnect - meaning you stay in control of every action.
 
Connection Link: https://github.com/edkdev/defi-trading-mcp
Note: this connection requires wallet access - always start with a test wallet
 
#6: CoinGecko MCP ( @coingecko )
If you've been following me for a while, you may remember CoinGecko MCP being one of the first MCP servers I ever set up.
 
It's an excellent connection and probably the most comprehensive crypto data source on this entire list. 
Best for real-time price feeds, access to millions of tokens, on-chain data, trending token analysis, and related topics.
 
Connection Link: https://docs.coingecko.com/docs/ai-agent-hub/mcp-server
 
#5: altFINS
This is the server built specifically for traders who want actionable intelligence rather than raw price feeds.
The altFINS MCP server provides 300+ pre-computed data points per coin.
including 150+ technical indicators - RSI, MACD & more.
 
Connection Link: https://altfins.com/crypto-market-and-analytical-data-api/documentation/mcp-server/
 
#4: GOAT SDK
GOAT SDK turns Claude from a pure research assistant into an executioner.
GOAT is an on-chain agent toolkit that you can use for real swaps, token transfers, balance checks, DeFi interactions, and more.
 
Connection Link: https://github.com/goat-sdk/goat
Note: this connection requires wallet access - always start with a test wallet
 
#3: Perplexity ( @perplexity_ai )
Every other server on this list connects Claude to a specific data source. Perplexity MCP connects Claude to the entire live internet and is my #1 source not only for crypto research but for ALL financial research.
 
Connection Link: https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/integrations/mcp-server
 
#2: Dune ( @Dune )
You won't find another crypto tool as powerful as Dune for on-chain analytics.
Best for on-chain deep dives, deep research, and prompting custom dashboards.
 
Connection Link: https://docs.dune.com/api-reference/agents/mcp
 
#1: TradingView 
My #1 crypto/finance MCP right now is hands down the new TradingView connection.
Best for: managing alerts, scanning your charts in real-time, deep technical analysis, coding custom indicators, and more.
In case you missed it, here is my full TradingView guide where I walk you through how to set it up, real prompt examples, and more:
 
Connection Link: https://github.com/LewisWJackson/tradingview-mcp-jackson

Claude Projects (No Coding Required)
